title: Bind API-created source connectors to the authenticated caller tenant
summary: Enforce tenant binding on API-created source connectors. POST /api/source-ingest/connectors for non-controller connectors requires an authenticated write-capable principal (operator, admin, persona.admin) and binds the resolved caller tenant to connector metadata.tenant_id. Requests with mismatched explicit tenant or unresolvable tenant fail closed with 403 TENANT_SCOPE_DENIED. Lifecycle and schedule writes require a caller admitted for the connector's tenant. Controller-owned connectors continue using the existing controller-token fence. All in-repo callers, e2e clients, and smoke scripts now provide authenticated write headers.
